cwe_content.cwe: CWE-1236,Improper Neutralization of Formula Elements in a CSV File

candidate.Reason: The ExcelReportWriter does not sanitize input data before writing to Excel cells, allowing potential formula injection when data starts with '=' or other formula indicators.
The CSVReportWriter does not sanitize input data before writing to CSV, allowing potential formula injection when data starts with '=' or other formula indicators.
The format_data function does not include any sanitization for potentially dangerous input that could be used for formula injection in Excel or CSV files.
